method: Mechanical map of the 2,085 A1-created functions in 0x5d6fe0-0x670a10 (r2a functions.csv) to docs/mission-code-map.md s7/s8 (parsed: address->Init/Watch kas2c contexts, ICF home name from s7.1, block per script). All 2,085 r2a names equal the doc home name (already applied, source IMPORTED); 0 address/name mismatches. kas2c shape checked on every decompiled body: scope prologue DAT_00c3749c matches context 2085/2085, mission scope name = cat_kasHashString('missionNN'/'tutorial1') 36/36, FSM/state scope name from CurrentTeamP+0x58 2049/2049, kasJump hash = hash(state in callee name) 1250/1250 checkable, kasFSMCreate hash = hash(FSM) 229/229; 40 bodies read by hand. Helpers: an objdump sweep of the whole range finds no call/jmp to any FUN_* (only kas* runtime, kasf*, nullsub, aitMsgSend, cat_aitMsgQueueRemoveAt), so no mission<NN>_ helpers exist. Body truncation measured against the doc's sizes and the sweep's callees.
